_help: Written to clients/<slug>/brand/<slug>-brand.json by tools/new-client.js, or copy it by hand. Every _help key is deleted as its section is completed, and the Phase 1 gate in workflow/client-portal.workflow.json fails while any remain. Every value marked PLACEHOLDER builds a working grey-box portal on day one and is replaced by a sampled value in Phase 1. clients/onyx/brand/onyx-brand.json is the worked example.

meta._help: status moves draft → captured-from-public-site → confirmed-by-client. confirmWithClient is the open-items list the brand sheet and the handover pack both print.
confirmWithClient: Master logo files (SVG or AI) for the lockup and the mark
Any existing brand guideline document; the hex values here are pixel-sampled from the live site
Photo library and usage rights for staff portraits used inside the portal
Legal entity name for the portal footer
Which booking, member or point-of-sale system the client runs, so the portal can deep-link to it and the reports can read its exports

identity._help: The client's own words. Positioning and promise are quotes from their site, not paraphrases.

voice._help: Five tone words, then rules a copywriter can follow. Vocabulary is what the client calls things.

logo._help: Describe the geometry in words as well as pointing at the file, so a stand-in can be drawn.

color._help: palette holds every colour with hex, rgb, name and usage; mark derived ones as Derived. roles point at palette keys and drive tokens.css. build-tokens.js fails on a role that names a missing key. Rename the keys to the client's own colours (ONYX uses black, green, amber) and point the roles at them.

primary.name: Primary
primary.usage: PLACEHOLDER. Replace with the sampled brand colour.

cta.name: Call to action
cta.usage: PLACEHOLDER. Replace with the colour the site uses for buttons.

white.name: White
white.usage: Headings and body on the dark canvas.

ink.name: Ink
ink.usage: Text on primary or cta fills where AA is required. Derived.

primaryDeep.name: Primary deep
primaryDeep.usage: PLACEHOLDER. Pressed state of primary controls; the primary about 20% darker. Derived.

primaryTint.name: Primary tint
primaryTint.usage: PLACEHOLDER. Selected rows and the active nav: the primary at 15%, as an eight-digit hex. Never the solid primary, or the active nav's label disappears into it. Derived.

ctaDeep.name: CTA deep
ctaDeep.usage: PLACEHOLDER. Pressed state of call-to-action buttons. Derived.

surface2.name: Surface raised
surface2.usage: Hover states, nested panels, dark inputs. Derived.

typography._help: One family. Record the weights in use. Scale steps are the ones tokens.css and the sheet expect; keep the keys, change the values. PLACEHOLDER family is Poppins because its woff2 files already sit in template/portal/fonts; add the client's family there as <family>-<weight>.woff2 to embed it.

components._help: One entry per pattern seen on the site: fill, text, border, radius, case, size, and a note on the portal variant where the site pattern fails contrast.

simstudio._help: The six decisions from Settings → Brand kits, plus shape and strength. Save the kit under the client's name and export it beside this file.

highlight.paints: the click target, the arrow, the typed field

box.paints: a region to read, drawn apart from the target

calloutPaper.paints: the card the prompt sits on

wrongAttempt.paints: a miss and the note that follows it
